headline: JITF Infralogistics holds Extraordinary General Meeting
hook: Routine shareholder meeting concluded at JITF
summary: JITF Infralogistics Limited has updated the stock exchanges regarding the proceedings of its Extraordinary General Meeting held on October 01, 2026. Such corporate filings document routine governance actions taken by the company. Shareholders typically review procedural approvals and resolutions passed during these meetings. For retail investors, this is a standard compliance filing with no immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on retail holdings.

headline: JITF Infralogistics submits Annual General Meeting minutes
hook: AGM minutes filed after September meeting
summary: JITF Infralogistics Limited has submitted the official minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on September 1, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing records the formal conclusion and proceedings of the meeting as per regulatory requirements. Retail shareholders can review the filed document for details on shareholder resolutions discussed during the AGM.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
